question: Does the one candidate frozen by the mechanism-blocked CRN first look reproduce the required whole-run strategy-package activation, policy sensitivity, functional separation and guardrails on statistically independent policy and simulation identities?
scope: This protocol confirms whole-run activation, repertoire sensitivity and guardrails only. It does not claim new local complementarity evidence; exact-candidate held-out complementarity remains required before detector admission.
method: One fixed candidate versus one fixed live baseline on complete common-random-number rectangles. There is no candidate construction, ranking, tuning, optional expansion or second candidate.

entryGate.freeze: The execution manifest must bind this protocol, runner, probe, ledger identity and every numeric ceiling before the first observation.

cohorts.independence: Policy root 546, all 128 policy indices and every simulation seed are disjoint from the root-545 first look. The canonical policy snapshot hashes must also have zero overlap with the 64 first-look snapshots.
cohorts.commonRandomNumbers: Candidate and live use identical policy identities, policy simulation seeds and RandomBuild identities. Every registered endpoint is evaluated on its complete comparable rectangle.

gates.reliability: Zero candidate stalls or errors and zero candidate-added faults on both policy grids; zero candidate-added faults on every RandomBuild grid.
gates.activation: A policy is active for a package only when the final deck contains its registered producer and consumer and at least one of its four simulations records both registered applied and consumed events.
gates.functionalSeparation: Within each aspect, at least eight held-out policies activate each package without activating the other package.
gates.reachability: At least sixteen held-out policies acquire the final producer-consumer pair and record its consumer event for each package through the live reward/economy path.
gates.admission: All four package, identity, reliability, RandomBuild, Vow-5 and duration gates must pass. No endpoint absent from a complete matched rectangle supports confirmation.

estimator.activationUnit: Policy identity, aggregated over the same four policy simulation seeds.
estimator.randomBuild: Paired candidate-minus-live win indicator by separately named aspect-vow grid and RandomBuild seed.
estimator.duration: Paired candidate-minus-live mean combat turns per fight by aspect, policy identity and simulation seed.
estimator.bootstrap: Exactly 5000 deterministic paired bootstrap resamples with a fresh random.Random(421) stream per estimand.
estimator.multiplicity: No endpoint, threshold, cohort, package or bootstrap seed may be added or changed after the first observation.

decisionRules.success: All preregistered gates pass. Confirm exactly this one candidate and continue to exact-candidate held-out complementarity and detector work; do not select another scalar cell.
decisionRules.futility: Any fixed identity, activation, separation, reachability, reliability, RandomBuild or Vow-5 gate fails, or a duration interval lies wholly above 0.25. Reject this candidate, close the tested scalar family and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Only a duration interval is missing or straddles 0.25, or execution reaches an immutable-input, incomplete-rectangle, cache, engine, harness, row-cap or wall-cap fault. Record inconclusive at the cap and do not rerun or extend this protocol.
decisionRules.successAuthority: The one frozen scalar candidate is independently confirmed for exact-candidate complementarity and detector evaluation only. This does not authorise detector admission, product promotion, acceptance seeds or reserve seeds.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: The scalar family is closed. Continue structurally inside issue #421 without selecting another observed scalar cell.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Stop this protocol at decision boundary 3. Do not rerun, add rows or alter cohorts.

deterministicOwnership: post_v38_heldout_confirmation.py alone constructs both complete rectangles, invokes the bound simulator/cache, audits policy identity, evaluates every registered gate and selects the decision boundary with zero model-context tokens.

methodBoundary.adaptiveTuning: V39-style candidate-by-candidate tuning, alternative-cell substitution, cohort extension and promising-route support are forbidden.
